# ButtonSize

`Flare.Components.ButtonSize`

Size of a FlareButton on the shared Xs..Xl scale (Md is the default). Every step is at least 32 CSS px tall in the built-in themes, so the WCAG 2.5.8 target minimum of 24x24 CSS px is met at every size. The 44x44 (iOS) and 48x48 (Android) targets are platform guidance for touch, not a web requirement: use Md or larger where a finger is the primary input. An icon-only button has no visible label, so it must carry AriaLabel.

## Values

| Name | Value | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `Xs` | `0` | Extra small |
| `Sm` | `1` | Small |
| `Md` | `2` | Medium |
| `Lg` | `3` | Large |
| `Xl` | `4` | Extra large |
